--the senior queen of Citraketu who got a son through the blessings of अङ्गिरस्. When the child died of poison, she lamented deeply. भा. VI. १४. २८-48.

(III)--was stationed to defend the East gate of मथुरा by कृष्ण. Defeated कूपकर्ण, a minis- ter of बाण; was sent to हास्तिनपुर by कृष्ण to find out whether पान्डवस् had captured Drupada. He went and met द्रोण, Vidura and others, when युधिष्ठीर made enquiries of कृष्ण. He returned to द्वारका after taking leave of them and narrated to कृष्ण as he saw and heard; joined with अक्रूर to set up शतधन्वन् to kill सत्राजित् and take the jewel Syamantaka (s.v.) as he did not give his daughter in marriage as promised. Refused to help शत- dhanvan who solicited for it.
1: भा. X. ५०. २०[2]; [५१ (V) २५], [३०-31 and ६४]; [५६ (V) 2-१५]; ५

; Vi. IV. १३. ६७-83.

2: भा.

-9. २२ [2].

8: Vi. V. ३७. ४६.

1: भा. IX. २३. २३-4; Br. III. ६९. 8; M. ४३. १३; वा. ९४. 8; Vi. IV. ११. १०-11.
A king of the Hai- haya clan born in the कृतयुग of Vaivasvata epoch, वराह kalpa. His hundred sons died on account of a curse by Cyavana. He prayed to Sun god who taught him a व्रतम्, by observing which he got a long lived child.
2: M. ६८. 6-१२.

. ७६.

--a पर्व; when the sun goes to the first अम्श, the moon is in the fourth अम्श of विशाख. वा. २३. १०७; ५०. ९६; ५३. १०५.

--a name of शिव. सती who was created by ब्रह्मा was given to him and a number of sons were born who were of all shapes and crude forms and called generally Rudras; they were partakers of the offerings in शतरुद्र। On ब्रह्मा's request he did not procreate but became स्थाणु and महादेव। Br.
--a daughter of शुक and पीवरी, and mother of Brahmadatta; married the पाञ्चाल king अणुह; known also as Gau. भा. IX. २१. २५; M. १५. 8-9; ४९. ५७.
